svg.aria-label: Icarus – Autonomous Drone. Python · OpenCV · Raspberry Pi · MAVLink · Kalman Filter. Sep 2026 – Present. Sub-$250 quadcopter targeting ≤10 cm landing precision by fusing camera pose, optical flow and ToF height with a Kalman filter on a Pi Zero 2 W, replacing a $260 RTK-GPS receiver.
